newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends weaker amid high dlr demand.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends weaker amid high dlr demand.

text.p: Active dollar buying by importers kept the Bangladesh taka under pressure to finish weaker at 42.8400/8480 in interbank trade on Monday, dealers said.

The taka was quoted at 42.8400/8500 per dollar in early trade and the greenback retained its edge till the close. "There were significant deals (in dollars) as many banks are under obligation to pay off import bills," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed unchanged at 5.0 to 5.5 percent, and dealers said call money would remain soft until the next auction of central bank bills on March 5.
